Immortals (abbreviated as IMT) is an American esports organization owned by Immortals Gaming Club (IGC), primarily known for their League of Legends team.

History

[edit]
See also: History of Immortals

Timeline

[edit]
  • 2016
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • Show All
  • June 1st - Immortals acquires the roster of Tempo Storm. [1]
  • July 22nd - Immortals replace SHOOWTiME with zews - who was the coach of the core of the roster during their team with Games Academy. [2]
  • November 4th - Immortals replace zews with steel. [3]
  • February 5th - Immortals and SK Gaming swap felps and fnx. [4]
  • May 15th - Immortals bench fnx due to internal issues within the team. [5]
  • May 24th - Immortals announce that kNgV- will tryout for the team on loan from Red Reserve. [6]
  • July 23rd - Immortals place 2nd at PGL Major Kraków 2017, losing to Gambit Esports 1-2 in the grand-final.
  • July 25th - kNgV- is acquired from Red Reserve. [7]
  • September 20th - Immortals parts ways with kNgV-. [8]
  • September 22nd - LUCAS1 and HEN1 are benched. [9]
  • October 3rd - Immortals confirm the signing of horvy. [10]
  • October 10th - Immortals sign destiny. [11]
  • October 13th - Immortals sign zqk. [12]
  • October 31st - TACO from SK Gaming announces that boltz will be playing for SK on loan, but will remain playing for Immortals for the remainder of ECS Season 4. [13]
  • November 7th - Immortals confirm shz move. [14]
  • November 13th - steel is transferred to Team Liquid. [15]
  • December 1st - horvy announces he is going inactive on Immortals while looking for new opportunities with North American teams. [16]
  • December 2nd - zakk announces his departure from Immortals. [17]
  • December 12th - 100 Thieves announce their acquisition of HEN1, LUCAS1, and fnx. [18]
  • December 21st - Tempo Storm announces their acquisition of shz and destiny. [19]
  • January 21st - zqk is acquired by YeaH! Gaming. [20]
  • February 21st - lurppis joins as General Manager. [21]
  • June 23rd - boltz is transferred to the MIBR team, which is owned by Immortals. [22]
  • August 10th - horvy's contract expires and he becomes a free agent. [23]
